title: Ulyana and the Ledger
author: B. M. Dunmore
blurb: August Brightwater, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
